'''2010 US West Nationals Day 2 Matt Thornton LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Thornton]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' I came in last at a local 2 weeks ago
* '''Username:''' BrenDerlin
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2

== Decklist ==

The sheet says the deck is the same as the player's [[2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Matt Thornton LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|list from the day before]], with these changes: -Tawss Khaa (V) / +Tantive IV (V). The list below applies them.
